title: The feedback guard counts a repeated heading with the same time and quote as one message
why: Retrospective session's mistake, 16:16 and 16:18 CST Nov 10 (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard); owner 16:20 CST: "this osunds like an error btw is it not".
note: The session appended a heading plus the owner's quote after hooks/feedback_guard.py had written the same; the item landed under the second copy, and the Stop hook refused twice. Fix: an item under either copy counts. Cost: none beyond the parse it already does. Not a ruling.
